name: Akroma
description: An angel sent by Ixidor to battle the deathwurms, who could not stop them.

description_citations.text: "Wurm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamhal's Soul Reaper slays Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, leading to the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: leading Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka to all be slain by the attack.

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl, Phage and Akroma fight in the Grand Coliseum; Akroma loses her legs and Kamahl wins.
timeline.quote: After a three-way bout with Kamahl and Akroma in the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka, their essences forming Karona.
timeline.quote: The essence of the three women blended into a new being

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids is injured commanding Cabal forces, used by Akroma, then serves Stonebrow before escaping to rejoin the Cabal.
timeline.quote: She eventually managed to escape and rejoin the Cabal.

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kidnaps Jeska, and the Cabal Patriarch turns her into Phage; Kamahl and Phage fight until Akroma interrupts and they defeat her together.
timeline.quote: who tried to kill her, but instead turned her into Phage

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma, created by Ixidor's imagination, treats clerics as allies in her war against Phage.
timeline.quote: She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

citation.text: Akroma's Blessing (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ixidor imagines the ruin of enemies and Akroma makes it so.
timeline.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

citation.text: Akroma's Vengeance (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma vows to stay her hand only when Phage is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

citation.text: Righteous Cause (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pacified by Akroma, even born warriors lay down their blades at her feet.
timeline.quote: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

citation.text: Pacifism (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken and abandoned in the desert over gambling debts, Ixidor shapes Akroma from his dream at the cost of his right arm, charging her to avenge Nivea.
timeline.quote: Ixidor gave her but one objective: to avenge Nivea, no matter the cost.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma attacks Phage in the Grand Coliseum, but Kamahl interferes and Phage's touch maims Akroma's legs.
timeline.quote: Akroma had to flee, grievously wounded and maimed as her legs fell victim to Phage's touch.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor heals and enhances Akroma, dreaming a jaguar whose legs replace hers, making her a centaur-angel.
timeline.quote: Akroma's legs were replaced by those of the jaguar.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War Akroma leads Ixidor's creations against the Cabal and Krosans until Phage releases deathwurms; Nivea's soul swallows Ixidor.
timeline.quote: The last deathwurm, the soul of Nivea, sought out Ixidor, swallowed him, and escaped as Akroma watched helplessly.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor discovers his reality-sculpting powers and uses them to create the angel Akroma.
timeline.quote: Ixidor uses his new power to create the angel Akroma .

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor dreams Phage has come for him and wakes with the angel Akroma, whom he sends to eliminate Phage.
timeline.quote: He agrees, then sends her to eliminate Phage.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma interrupts Kamahl's second fight with Phage; Kamahl cuts the angel's legs and she flees.
timeline.quote: the druid cuts the angel's legs, and Akroma flees.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska absorbs the wurms back and becomes Phage again, despising Kamahl.
timeline.quote: she returns to being Phage and once again despises the druid

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma takes control of Topos and Kamahl swears to save his sister.
timeline.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor sends Akroma to fight the deathwurms but even the angel cannot stop them.
timeline.quote: Ixidor sent Akroma to battle them but not even the angel was able to stop them.

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma asks her troops for unwavering loyalty.
timeline.quote: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

citation.text: Akroma's Devoted (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akroma spreads Ixidor's message, effectively founding a religion around him.
timeline.quote: effectively founding a religion around him

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma flies to the Sanctum to confront Phage, who says it will be a war of words.
timeline.quote: Phage claimed that this would not be a war of swords but a war of words.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow's assassination attempt is foiled and he is converted to Akroma's cause; she then dives into a portal to confront the deathwurm.
timeline.quote: she jumped into the portal to confront her master

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The wurm swallows Akroma; inside she finds Ixidor wishing to stay with Nivea's spirit and leaves him, her feet and wings eaten by acid.
timeline.quote: He wallowed in grief and wished to remain with the spirit of his dear Nivea.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and the Cabal, in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and the Cabal , in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma .

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a final battle between Phage and Akroma, the two and Zagorka merge to form Karona.
timeline.quote: the two beings and Zagorka merge to form Karona

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos; Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone.
timeline.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos once she has learned that Ixidor is no longer.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma finds the last unman and names him Umbra, then brainwashes the feeble Braids to learn Cabal secrets.
timeline.quote: Finally, she finds a feeble Braids and brainwashes her to be her follower.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage sways Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: to be the mother of the reincarnation of the Cabal god, Kuberr .

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow tries to kill Akroma, is brainwashed to worship Ixidor, and then leads Topos in war on Sanctum when Akroma vanishes after the deathwurm.
timeline.quote: He becomes the angel's obedient servant.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Inside the deathwurm, Akroma finds Ixidor, who heals her and shows her the way out.
timeline.quote: He heals his creation, though, and shows her the way out.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both; Phage flees to give birth.
timeline.quote: Phage, wounded and weakened by pregnancy, flees to give birth.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma gives Sash and Waistcoat bodies to kill them, but Umbra sacrifices himself, closing the portal.
timeline.quote: Umbra jumps on them, making them go through him and closing the portal, dying in the process.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuberr and Akroma's armies fight at Sanctum, which has become a twisted reflection of itself.
timeline.quote: The angel and the Cabalist fight bitterly and without mercy.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, crashing onto Phage and Akroma as Soul Reaper falls and kills them all; the goddess Karona is born.
timeline.quote: From the combination of their three souls and bodies, and the magic of Soul Reaper, the goddess Karona is born.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma marches on the Sanctum and fights Phage atop the dome.
timeline.quote: the two women trading blows with one another

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; Akroma dies in peace and Karona is born.
timeline.quote: Akroma finally died in peace, knowing that Ixidor had been avenged at last.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A memorial statue of Akroma holding her sword is built by 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: a memorial had been built to honor her in the form of a statue of her image that holds her sword

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts Averru's plans by triggering the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: disrupted Averru's plans by triggering the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Averru", section "Reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
timeline.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma, Phage and Zagorka are slain by Kamahl's Soul Reaper at the apex of their battle, and Karona is reborn from their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: wrought from the fused bodies of the three great women

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Armies converge on Sanctum; Akroma's forces are admitted by the Glyphs, which twist her soldiers' loyalty to Lowallyn.
timeline.quote: Akroma , leading the forces of Topos , was granted entrance to the city by the strange Glyph people

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma and Phage meet again in mortal combat in the dome at the city's heart.
timeline.quote: Akroma and Phage met once more in mortal combat

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Soul Reaper cleaves Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; their simultaneous deaths unleash ancient magic and a blinding explosion.
timeline.quote: The Soul Reaper struck true against Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka, cleaving them all in twain.

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage and Akroma's war ends with their deaths and fusion into Karona, leaving Otaria torn by militant factions.
timeline.quote: With the vicious war between Phage and Akroma , and their followers, over with their deaths and fusion into Karona

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper fuses Akroma, Phage and Zagorka into the goddess Karona; the armies stop fighting to worship her.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's Soul Reaper has cut through Akroma , Phage , and Zagorka to fuse them into one being: the goddess Karona.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Karona is killed the three women separate and Jeska's spark ignites, making her a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the three women separated

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umbra tracks the two rogue unmen to Eroshia.
timeline.quote: Umbra tracked the two down in the city of Eroshia

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Legions: card flavor text (Legions, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
